title: Hidden Phase Transition in Single-Polymer Stretching under Elongational Flow
summary: Jointly learned neural potentials locate a distinct transition in the modeled polymer dynamics; single-molecule imaging separately measured a qualitative response reversal, while not validating the exact learned threshold.
